messages:
jessica: Proposal — add event_schema_version + namespaced attribute bag to support nonbreaking telemetry changes. want to avoid constant backfills and fragile SELECTs.

mike: +1. can you sketch the shape? how do we query old vs new attributes from analytics?

jessica: idea: keep events table as-is, add 'attrs_v2' JSONB nullable and an integer 'schema_version'. SDKs set schema_version on new clients. server-side ingestion will accept both.

omar: sounds OK. we should define compatibility view for dashboards so existing queries don't break. prefer a materialized view for heavy dashboards.

kevin: curious about storage cost and backfill. how big is attrs_v2 likely to be?

jessica: quick estimate: average attrs_v2 ~ 800 bytes. our weekly event volume ~ 50m rows -> ~40GB/week. backfill for last 90 days -> ~160GB. tolerable on dev infra, but need throttled backfill for prod.

sara: from product side: need guarantees that rollout won't change any existing metric semantics. customers rely on exact field paths.

mike: propose migration plan: 1) API/SDK bump to write schema_version=2 and new namespaced keys, 2) ingestion accepts and writes attrs_v2, 3) create compatibility SQL view 'events_compat' that coalesces attrs_v2->attrs for queries, 4) backfill historical rows incrementally.

jessica: config snippets:
```sql
ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN schema_version int DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN attrs_v2 jsonb;
CREATE INDEX ON events ((schema_version));
```
backfill job will transform rows where attrs_v2 IS NULL using a lightweight mapping script.

omar: mapping script needs to be idempotent. also include checksum to avoid double work.

kevin: for rollout safety add a feature flag in ingestion to skip writing attrs_v2 for a short period if we see spike/errors. deploy-bot can flip it.

deploy-bot: new deploy pipeline job created: event-schema/migrate-v2 ; stages: dry-run -> canary 1% -> canary 10% -> full. logs to #incidents if error rate > 0.5%.

sara: dashboards: we should not change any BI queries. if a dashboard wants to use new v2 fields opt-in via query param. add note in changelog.

mike: compatibility view idea:
```sql
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW events_compat AS
SELECT id, ts, COALESCE(attrs_v2, attrs) AS attrs, schema_version FROM events;
```
materialized refresh hourly; heavy dashboards can point there.

jessica: agree. for time-series we can precompute extracted columns into an events_metrics table to avoid JSON parsing at query time.

omar: backfill plan: run in 6-hour windows, 2 threads per region, pause if avg write latency > 25ms. provide estimated completion: ~10 days for 90d window.

kevin: need monitoring: queue depth, backfill progress metric, error rate, DB IO. add alert if backfill lag > 12h.

sara: one more ask — expose schema_version in the console event inspector so support can triage.

jessica: will add column to Console UI and a filter for schema_version. also add migration playbook for support.

mike: outstanding questions: 1) rename collisions — what if attrs_v2 uses same top-level keys as attrs? we should namespace new keys under "v2" root to avoid shadowing.

jessica: good call. final plan: attrs_v2 will be {"v2": { ... }} and compatibility view will prefer attrs_v2->'v2' keys over attrs. mapping rules stored as code in telemetry repo.

omar: +1. I'd like a quick smoke test script we can run pre/post backfill to validate parity on a sample of rows.

jessica: I'll add a smoke test (1000 rows compare digest of normalized attrs). will post the script to the PR.

kevin: timeline: SDK bump + ingestion acceptance -> canary next week -> create compatibility view -> start backfill two days after canary stable.

sara: product ok with that timeline. add customer comms template.

mike: will open PR for DB DDL + materialized view + backfill job. tagging @omar for review.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-2391 for event schema v2 rollout and added it to the eng-platform sprint.

jessica: thanks everyone — I'll drop the RFC + checklist in the thread and start the PR.
